claim_review.context_quote: xported to ONNX, each fake-quantization operation in the framework’s graph is exported as a pair of QuantizeLinear and DequantizeLinear ONNX operators. ONNX introduced support for QuantizeLinear and DequantizeLinear in opset 10, and a quantization-axis attribute was added in opset 13 (required for per-channel quantization).
